# Load combined data

```{r}
p2f.input <- here("data","inputs_GP_BP_FHB.rds")
file.mtime(p2f.input) #"2026-03-06 13:37:01 CST"
tools::md5sum(p2f.input) # 89e2797da1f8d74bded5113a22a07bc2
dat <- readRDS(p2f.input)
## unlist elements and add them to the environment
list2env(dat, globalenv())
pheno <- gv
table(pheno$BP)
(BPs <- unique(pheno$BP))
(traits <- colnames(pheno)[!colnames(pheno) %in% c("GID","BP")])
GRM <- rrBLUP::A.mat(geno-1)
gid.nur <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% "NUR"]
print_table(fitSummary)
```


## Genotype information for nursery genotypes

```{r load-nur-info}
#nur.info <- fread(here("data","genotype_information_URN_URSN_URNFHB.tsv"))
dim(nur.info)
table(nur.info$SOURCE)
gid.nur <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% "NUR"] ## 881
setdiff(gid.nur, nur.info$GID)
nur.info$SOURCE <- forcats::fct_lump_min(nur.info$SOURCE, min=50, other_level = "OTHER")
table(nur.info$SOURCE)
pheno <- pheno |> 
  left_join(nur.info |> dplyr::select(GID,SOURCE), by="GID")
head(pheno)

## add breeding program for the nursery genotypes in the phenotype table
pheno$NUR.BP <- ifelse(pheno$BP=="NUR", paste0("NUR-",pheno$SOURCE), pheno$BP)
pheno <- pheno |> dplyr::select(-SOURCE) |> 
  relocate(NUR.BP, .after=BP)
table(pheno$NUR.BP)
```

```{r summ_table, warning=FALSE,attr.message=F}
                   include=all_of(traits.sel),
```

# Plot

## Genetic structure

PCA analysis based on the GRM imputed by the mean

```{r geno_struct}
## build genomic relationship matrix
dim(GRM)
ap(GRM)
#superheat::superheat(GRM, pretty.order.rows=F, pretty.order.cols=F)

## run PCA analysis
res.pca.geno <- ade4::dudi.pca(df=GRM, nf=2, scannf = FALSE)
factoextra::fviz_eig(res.pca.geno,addlabels = TRUE)

df.bp <- pheno |> dplyr::select(GID,NUR.BP,BP) |> distinct()

df.col <- df.bp[match(colnames(GRM), df.bp$GID),]
head(df.col)


## color for population (trial or nursery)
cols <- c("MN"="#7a0019","ND"="#2E8B57","SD"="#3A5FCD","MT"="#bd9b04",
          "NUR-NA"="snow3","NUR-AAFC-CA"="#bf8ea1","NUR-PRIVATE"="#8A42C9",
          "NUR-OTHER"="grey50","NUR"="grey50",
          "NUR-MN"="#ed694e","NUR-ND"="#a1d99b","NUR-SD"="#9ecae1",
          "NUR-MT"="#f7e084")
# factoextra::fviz_pca_ind(res.pca,geom="point",addEllipses = FALSE, col.ind="white")+
#   geom_point(aes(color=df.col$NUR.BP), size=2, alpha=0.8)+
#   theme_bw(base_size=13)+
#   scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
#   ggtitle("Genomic PCA all") +
#   theme(legend.position="bottom")
#geom_label_repel(data=res.pca$li[checks,],mapping=aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2, label=checks), min.segment.length = 0)
var1 <- round(res.pca.geno$eig[1]/sum(res.pca.geno$eig)*100,1)
var2 <- round(res.pca.geno$eig[2]/sum(res.pca.geno$eig)*100,1)

## interactive plot
df.pca <- res.pca.geno$li
df.pca$GID <- rownames(df.pca)
df.pca <- merge(df.col,df.pca)

ggplot(df.pca, aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2, label=GID,color=NUR.BP))+
  geom_point(size=1.5,alpha=0.8)+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  labs(x=paste0("Axis 1 (",round(res.pca.geno$eig[1]/sum(res.pca.geno$eig)*100,1),"%)"),
       y=paste0("Axis 2 (",round(res.pca.geno$eig[2]/sum(res.pca.geno$eig)*100,1),"%)"))+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        panel.grid = element_blank())

# ## start device
# png(here("output","figures",paste0("PCA_inds_geno_all-BPs_interactive.png")),
#     width=8, height=6, res=150)
# plotly::ggplotly(p)
# dev.off()


df.pca <- df.pca |> 
  mutate(isNUR = ifelse(BP %in% "NUR", "NUR","BP"),
         NUR.BP = factor(NUR.BP)) |> 
  mutate(NUR.BP=forcats::fct_relevel(NUR.BP, "SD","ND"))
levels(df.pca$NUR.BP)
table(df.pca$isNUR)

p <- df.pca |> 
  mutate(isNUR=recode(isNUR, "NUR"="Nursery", "BP"="Breeding program")) |>
  ggplot( aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2, label=GID,color=NUR.BP))+
  facet_wrap(~isNUR) +
  gghighlight::gghighlight()+
  geom_point(size=1.5,alpha=0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.9)+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(alpha=1,size=3)))+
  labs(x=paste0("Axis 1 (",var1,"%)"),
       y=paste0("Axis 2 (",var2,"%)"))+
  #ggtitle(paste0("Genomic PCA - Breeding program"))+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background=element_rect(color="grey85"), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color="grey85"))
#esquisse::ggplot_to_ppt(gg="p")
p
ggsave(filename = here("output","figures",paste0("PCA_inds_geno_NUR-all-BPs.png")),
       width=8, height=6, scale=0.85)
#rm(GRM)
```

Plot separately for breeding programs and for nursery

```{r}
pBP <- df.pca |> filter(isNUR %in% "BP") |> 
  ggplot( aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2, label=GID,color=NUR.BP))+
  geom_point(size=1.2,alpha=0.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.85)+
  ## keep same scales
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(min(df.pca$Axis1), max(df.pca$Axis1)))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(min(df.pca$Axis2), max(df.pca$Axis2)))+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(alpha=1,size=3), nrow=3))+
  labs(x=paste0("Axis 1 (",var1,"%)"),
       y=paste0("Axis 2 (",var2,"%)"),
       title="Breeding Program Entries")+
  #ggtitle(paste0("Genomic PCA - Nursery genotypes"))+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        plot.title=element_text(size=14))


pNUR <- df.pca |> filter(isNUR %in% "NUR") |>
  ggplot( aes(x=Axis1, y=Axis2, label=GID,color=NUR.BP))+
  geom_point(size=1.2,alpha=0.6)+
  ## keep same scales
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(min(df.pca$Axis1), max(df.pca$Axis1)))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(min(df.pca$Axis2), max(df.pca$Axis2)))+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Nursery source")+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.85)+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(alpha=1,size=3), nrow=3))+
  labs(x=paste0("Axis 1 (",var1,"%)"),
       y=paste0("Axis 2 (",var2,"%)"),
       title="Nursery Entries")+
  #ggtitle(paste0("Genomic PCA - Nursery genotypes"))+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        plot.title=element_text(size=14))
  

pPCA = pBP+pNUR + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size=15, face="bold"),
        legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top")
pPCA
```


## Phenotype distribution by trait

```{r plot_distrib, warning=F}
for(tr in traits){
  #tr="YLD"
  plot(ggplot(pheno, aes(x=BP, y=.data[[tr]]))+
         ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(alpha=0.2)+
         stat_summary()+
         bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8))
}
```


Distribution for URN/URSN

```{r}
pheno.long <- pheno |> 
  filter(BP %in% "NUR", NUR.BP %in% c("NUR-SD","NUR-ND","NUR-MT","NUR-MN")) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=all_of(traits), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") |> 
  mutate(trait=factor(trait, levels=traits))
distri.nur <- ggplot(pheno.long, aes(x=value, y=NUR.BP,  fill=NUR.BP, color=NUR.BP))+
  #ggdist::stat_eye(position = "dodge", size=1) +
  #ggdist::stat_dots(position = "dodge", scale=0.5, alpha=0.6)+
  geom_density_ridges2(alpha=0.8,linewidth=0.3, color=NA,scale = 1,
                       quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2,rel_min_height =0.01,
                       vline_width=0.7, vline_color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~trait, scales="free_x")+
  #theme_minimal(base_size=14)+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  labs(x="BLUP value",y="URN FHB + URSN genotype source")+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  #ggtitle("Phenotypic distribution by trait and BP")+
  geom_rug(linewidth=0.2,length = unit(0.05, "npc"),alpha=0.7)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        panel.border = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey60", linewidth=0.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey60", linewidth=0.2))
distri.nur
ggsave(here("output","figures","Pheno-distrib_by-trait_and-NUR-BP.png"),
       width=9, height=6, scale=0.8)
```


## Wheat class effect

ND distribution by wheat class
```{r}
phenoND <- pheno |> filter(BP %in% "ND")
phenoND$CLASS <- NA
phenoND$CLASS[grep("^NDR|^NDHRS", phenoND$GID)] <- "RED"
phenoND$CLASS[grep("^NDW",phenoND$GID)] <- "WHITE"
phenoND$GID[is.na(phenoND$CLASS)]
phenoND$CLASS[is.na(phenoND$CLASS)] <- "CHECKS"
table(phenoND$CLASS)
phenoND.long <- phenoND |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=all_of(traits), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") 
```


Phenotypic distribution plot
```{r}
phenoND.long |> filter(CLASS %in% c("RED","WHITE"), trait %in% "DIS") |>
  ggplot( aes(x=value, y=CLASS, fill=CLASS, color=CLASS))+
  geom_density_ridges2(alpha=0.8,linewidth=0, color=NA,scale = 1,
                       quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2,rel_min_height =0.01,
                       vline_width=0.7, vline_color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~trait, scales="free_x")+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  labs(x="BLUP value",y="Wheat class")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("RED"="#D40F7DFF","WHITE"="wheat"), name="Wheat class")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("RED"="#D40F7DFF","WHITE"="wheat"),name="Wheat class")+
  geom_rug(linewidth=0.2,length = unit(0.05, "npc"),alpha=0.7)+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        panel.border = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey60", linewidth=0.5),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill="white", color="grey60", linewidth=0.))
ggsave(here("output","figures","Pheno-distrib_ND_by-wheat-class.png"),
       width=6, height=4, scale=0.85)

## statistical difference
phenoND.long |> filter(CLASS %in% c("RED","WHITE"), trait %in% "DIS") |>
  rstatix::wilcox_test(value ~ CLASS) |> 
  rstatix::add_significance() 
```




Genetic structure plot
```{r}
df.pca.ND <- merge(df.pca, phenoND |> dplyr::select(GID,CLASS), by="GID", all=F)
```

## Phenotypic structure

```{r}
dat.pca <- pheno |> dplyr::select(all_of(c("GID",traits))) 
## remove rows with too little observations
rs <- rowSums(is.na(dat.pca)) ; idx <- which(rs >= 2)
dat.pca <- dat.pca[-idx,]

dat.pca <- dat.pca |> mutate(across(traits, \(x) 
                                    metan::replace_na(x, replacement=mean(x, na.rm=T)))) |> 
  metan::column_to_rownames("GID") |> as.matrix()
res.pca <- ade4::dudi.pca(df=dat.pca, nf=2, scannf = FALSE)

factoextra::fviz_eig(res.pca,addlabels = TRUE)

df.col <- df.bp[match(rownames(dat.pca), df.bp$GID),]

factoextra::fviz_pca_biplot(res.pca,geom="point",
                            addEllipses = FALSE, col.ind="white")+
  geom_point(aes(color=df.col$BP), size=2, alpha=0.8)+
  theme_bw(base_size=13)+
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  ggtitle("Phenotypic PCA all") + theme(legend.position="bottom")
ggsave(here("output","figures",paste0("PCA_inds_pheno_all-BPs.png")),
       width=7, height=6, scale=0.85)
```

## Figure for manuscript

Combine genetic (p) and phenotypic structure
```{r combine_plots, fig.height=7}
## load saved figure from HRSWGS_BP
fig <- readRDS(here("output","figures","plot_distrib_BP.rds"))

# p1 <- p + theme_bigstatsr(size=0.7) + 
#   guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2))+ 
#   theme(legend.position="bottom")
p2 <- fig + ylab("Population")+
  scale_y_discrete(labels=c("URSN_URN-FHB"="URSN \n+ URN"))+
  theme_bigstatsr(size=0.7) +
  theme(legend.position="none",axis.text.x=element_text(size=rel(0.8)))
p3 <- distri.nur + theme_bigstatsr(size=0.7) + theme(legend.position="none")
pall <- pPCA/(p2+p3) + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1), widths=c(1.1,1)) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size=15, face="bold")) & 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill="grey85", color="grey85"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color="grey85"),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=rel(0.9)))
pall
ggsave(here("output","figures",
            "combined-plot_genetic-structure_phenotypic-distrib_v2.png"), 
       height=8, width=11, scale=0.9)
#esquisse::ggplot_to_ppt(gg="pall")
```

## Experimental design by BP

```{r}
expeDesign |> 
  filter(!BP %in% c("URN","URSN_URN-FHB")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=LOC, x=nGeno, fill=as.factor(YEAR)))+
  facet_wrap(~BP, scales="free_y", labeller = "label_both")+
  #geom_point(size=2, alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(width=0.7))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge",color="white")+
  bigstatsr::theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name="Year", option="C")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=2))+
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))+
  labs(y="Location", x="Number of genotypes")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        strip.background=element_rect(color=NA), 
        panel.border = element_rect(color="grey85"),
        panel.grid=element_blank()
        #axis.text.y=element_blank()
  )
ggsave(here("output","figures","Expe-design_nTraits-by-LOC-year_by-BP.png"),
       width=9, height=7, scale=0.85)

## average ngeno by trial
expeDesign |> group_by(BP) |> 
  summarize(mean_nGeno_trial=round(mean(nGeno),1),
            sd_nGeno_trial=mean(sd(nGeno),1),
            n_trials=n(),
            n_years=length(unique(YEAR)),
            n_locs=length(unique(LOC))) |> 
  print_table()


```

Study URN and URSN experimental design

```{r}
expeDesign |> 
  # filter(BP %in% c("URN","URSN_URN-FHB")) |> 
  group_by(BP,YEAR) |>
  summarize(nGeno=mean(nGeno),
            nLoc=length(unique(LOC))) |>
  mutate(YEAR=as.numeric(YEAR)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=nGeno, x=YEAR, color=nLoc))+
  facet_wrap(~BP, scales="free")+
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks =scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5))+

  labs(y="Average number of genotypes", x="Year")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=-30, hjust=0, vjust=0.5),

ggsave(here("output","figures","Expe-design_nGeno-by-year_all-BPs.png"),
```

```{r}
  geom_point(size=3)+
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, linewidth=2)+
  scale_color_manual(values=trait.pal, name="Trait")+
  #paletteer::scale_color_paletteer_d("ggprism::stained_glass") +
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  labs(x="Number of observations", y="Cullis Heritability")#+
ggsave(here("output","figures","Fit-summary_H2-Cullis_by-trait_BP.png"),
       width=7, height=6, scale=0.85)
```

# Plot map of locations


```{r plot_map_locs, fig.width=7}
trial.coord <- trial.coord |> filter(!Abbreviation %in% "SDN")
cols <- c(cols, "URSN_URN-FHB"="grey40")

expe_locs <- expeDesign |> group_by(BP, LOC, Location) |>
  summarize(nTrials=n(), .groups="drop") |> 
  mutate(Location=ifelse(LOC %in% "MRD", "Morden",Location)) |> 
  left_join(trial.coord, by=c("Location"="Location")) 
expe_locs |> summarize(sum(nTrials), .by=BP)
locs_only <- expe_locs |> select(LOC,Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct()
smallworld <- ne_states(country =c("united states of america","canada"),
                        returnclass = "sf")

## coordinates of US states and CAN provinces
df_annot <- data.frame(
  state = c("Minnesota", "South Dakota", "North Dakota", "Manitoba"),
  long = c(-94.5, -100, -100, -100),
  lat = c(47, 45, 47, 50.5)
)

xlims=c(-105,-92)
ylims=c(43,51.5)

smallworld %>%
  st_transform(crs = "+proj=longlat") %>%
  ggplot() +
  
  geom_sf(linewidth=1) + xlab("Longitude")+ylab("Latitude")+
  theme_bigstatsr(size.rel=0.8)+
  geom_point(data=expe_locs, aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude, size=nTrials, color=BP), shape=1, stroke=1.5) +
  # geom_label_s(data=locs_only, aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude,label=LOC),
  #             position = position_nudge_center(x=1,y=1, direction = "radial"), min.segment.length = 0,size=3,
  #             segment.linewidth = 0.2,alpha.target ="box.fill",alpha=0.7,
  #             fill="white",color.target = "all",color="black") +
  geom_label_repel(data=locs_only, aes(x=Longitude, y=Latitude,label=LOC),
                   direction="both",seed=45,
                   min.segment.length=0.1, size=4,
                   segment.color="black",alpha=0.7,label.padding=0.1,
                   color="black",box.padding=0.1,force=0.5, 
                   nudge_x=ifelse(locs_only$Longitude < -97, -0.4, 0.4),
                   nudge_y=ifelse(locs_only$Latitude < 47, -0.4, 0.4),
                   segment.size=0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = df_annot$long, y = df_annot$lat, label = df_annot$state, color = "grey30", size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values=cols, name="Breeding program")+
  guides(size=guide_legend(title="Number of trials"),
         color=guide_legend(nrow=2))+
  coord_sf(xlim =xlims, ylim =ylims,crs = "+proj=longlat") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title.position="top",
        panel.grid = element_blank())
ggsave(file=here("output", "figures","map_FHB-trials_nursery-BP.png"),
       scale=0.8, width=7, height=7)
```
